Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata

Class HistoFitPrep.FitWindowData

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.FitVectors
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.HistoFitPrep.FitWindowData
Enclosing class:
HistoFitPrep
public static final class HistoFitPrep.FitWindowData extends FitVectors
A FitVectors that also records which peak bin and window were actually used.

Returned by the guarded best-peak methods so callers can log or display the window that was chosen.
